fieldissues.issue: The descriptions cover the February 1, 2025 Canada and Mexico tariff announcement and subsequent Canadian and Mexican retaliation, but the only retained URL is a Reuters report dated July 31 about raising Canada’s tariff from 25% to 35%.
The short repeats the title, and “fentanyl pretext” states a motive that the long attributes to Canadian and Chinese officials rather than establishing as fact.

proposedchanges.change: Add sources for the February Canada and Mexico tariffs and the listed retaliation, or narrow the entry to the July 31 Canada tariff increase covered by the retained Reuters report.
Remove “pretext” unless presented as an attributed criticism. Write a separate summary that identifies which tariffs and which retaliatory measures the resolved source set supports.

evidencebasis: The packet and merged text date the main Canada and Mexico tariff action to February 1, 2025, while its only source URL is Reuters’ July 31, 2025 report about a later Canada increase.
The long attributes the pretext characterization to Canadian and Chinese officials and says it is not an established finding about motive.
The Reuters URL is retained in the merged source_urls.
notes: The record’s February event and later measures need source coverage beyond the retained report, or the entry should be narrowed to that report’s July action.

fieldissues.issue: The title says the EU, India, and Japan retaliated with $109 billion in counter-tariffs, while the medium says the $109 billion applies to EU goods, India filed proposals, and Japan’s prime minister made a statement.
The descriptions combine EU, Canadian, Indian, and Japanese trade actions, but the sole retained BBC URL concerns India’s tariff dispute.
Government Corruption does not describe international tariff retaliation and trade disputes.

proposedchanges.change: Restore sources for the EU and Canadian countermeasures and Japan’s statement if the broader account remains. Otherwise narrow it to the India tariff and WTO claims covered by the retained BBC source.

Attribute the 93-billion-euro figure specifically to the EU package and distinguish counter-tariffs from WTO proposals and political statements. Write a separate short after the source scope is resolved.
Use an international trade or tariff-retaliation category rather than Government Corruption.

evidencebasis: The assigned packet distinguishes the EU package, Canadian tariffs, India’s WTO proposals, and Japan’s prime minister’s comment.
The merged title combines the actors and applies the EU’s $109 billion figure to all three; the source metadata and merged source_urls list only a BBC India tariff report.
The long also claims broad participation by trading partners without a retained source for the full set.
notes: The card conflates different forms of retaliation and assigns one figure to multiple actors. The broader account needs corresponding source coverage or narrower scope.

fieldissues.issue: The descriptions cover workplace leave, federal employee resource groups, contractor protections, surveillance, and an MSPB case, but the only retained URL is a Federal Register K–12 schooling order that does not document those employment and surveillance actions.
The short repeats the title, and “DEI purge and firings” compresses multiple different policies and employment actions into one broad claim.

proposedchanges.change: Restore the executive orders, OPM memo, Williams Institute estimate, DHS notice, and MSPB complaint sources for the actions retained. Otherwise narrow the description to the policy actually covered by the retained K–12 order.

After narrowing or restoring sources, use a title that identifies the specific employment action or protections at issue. Write a separate summary that distinguishes paid leave, contractor-policy changes, and the later complaint.

evidencebasis: The packet synopsis names several distinct federal employment and surveillance actions, while its listed source is a Federal Register K–12 schooling order.
The merged source_urls retain only that K–12 order, but the merged long states claims about OPM, DHS, contractor protections, and an MSPB filing.
The merged short repeats the broad title.
notes: The described actions are separate and require appropriate sources. The record should not carry the broad employment narrative on the retained K–12 order alone.

fieldissues.issue: The descriptions include February 26 exclusions, April removal of wire-service slots after an AP court challenge, and which outlets later gained access, but the only retained Reuters URL is dated February 25 and reports the initial press-pool change.

The short repeats the title, and “ejects” can imply that the listed outlets were barred from all White House coverage, although the long says the exclusions applied to pool rotations and not all coverage.

proposedchanges.change: Add sources for the February 26 meeting exclusions, April pool changes, and outlet assignments, or narrow the account to the February 25 announcement supported by Reuters.

Describe the administration’s control of press-pool selection and specify that exclusions affected particular rotations. Write a distinct short and avoid wording that implies a total ban on White House coverage.

evidencebasis: The packet gives the February and April actions, while the only source_metadata URL and merged source_urls entry is Reuters’ February 25 report.
The long says the reported exclusions did not bar the outlets from all White House coverage.
The merged title and short use “ejects” and repeat each other.
notes: The retained report covers the policy announcement but not the later dated events in the description. Add those sources or narrow the event.

fieldissues.issue: The title says Trump fired all commissioners, while the medium and long say he removed two Democratic members and a Republican member resigned. The short repeats the title.
organization_tags is empty even though the Election Assistance Commission is the central institution named in the account.

proposedchanges.change: Use “White House Removes Two EAC Commissioners as Third Resigns Ahead of Midterms.” Write a separate short that preserves the distinction between the two removals and McCormick’s resignation.
Add the Election Assistance Commission as an organization tag. Keep people_tags for the named commissioners and officials.

evidencebasis: The assigned packet and merged medium and long say Hicks and Hovland were removed and McCormick resigned.
The merged title says all commissioners were fired, a materially different account of McCormick’s departure.
The merged description names the Election Assistance Commission, but organization_tags is empty; the ProPublica URL remains in source_urls.
notes: The long distinguishes the personnel actions and says the commission’s statutory responsibilities continued. The card title should make the same distinction.
